RESULT [weeds]: In-domain (2025 lettuce): mAP50 84.9 -> 92.3 and mAP50-95 63.2 -> 72.3 over plain YOLO26. Cross-domain: +14.0 mAP50 on 3SeasonWeedDet10 (2021-23; 56.5 absolute) and +11.9 on 2024 data (41.5 absolute). Cost: 2.9x latency (12.0 -> 35.1 ms on an RTX A6000, about 28.5 fps).
US [weeds]: This is the closest published version of the professor's plan to first build a large, high-precision base dataset. It uses the big curated corpus to pretrain the backbone with self-supervision, not to supervise the detector, and that is where most of the cross-season gain comes from.
